name: pragma
description: Keeps the Pragmatic Programmer's 15 principles in play while Claude writes code: a design ladder injected each session, deterministic violation detection on every edit, and skills for design, review, debugging, refactoring and contracts.

mode.title: Enforcement mode
mode.description: One of: off (silent), lite (safety findings only), standard (safety + design), strict (everything, plus a reminder when new code ships without tests). Override per project with /pragma:mode.

maxFindingsPerEdit.title: Max findings reported per edit
maxFindingsPerEdit.description: Findings are ranked safety > design > style; the rest are dropped so the feedback stays short.

disabledDetectors.title: Disabled detectors
disabledDetectors.description: Comma-separated detector ids to silence in this codebase, e.g. naming/vague-name,config/direct-env. Each reported finding prints its id.
